title: Royal B Scout · Mon Nov 16 · 6:45am
big_picture: Futures are lower this morning, led by Nasdaq, with Nvidia down about 2-4% pre-market ahead of its report after Tuesday's close. Sources disagree on the size: one had Nasdaq 100 futures down 0.9% and S&P 500 futures down 0.3% early, a later undated roundup had them down 1.7% and 0.8%, so treat the sizes as approximate ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-intel-fall-jj-gains-5029397), [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/u-s-stocks-slip-as-nvidia-leadership-concerns-weigh-on-sentiment-ahead-of-q3-earnings)). The trigger is the headline: the Financial Times reported Sunday that Jensen Huang has discussed returning as CEO with confidants, citing unnamed people. That is a rumour, and Nvidia has not confirmed it ([Guru3D summary](https://www.guru3d.com/story/jensen-huang-reportedly-discusses-return-as-nvidia-ceo-amid-board-investigation), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/nvidia-jensen-huang-return-tech.html)). Intel is down about 5% on a shareholder class-action suit, a company-specific story. Oil is steady near Brent 95 and WTI 88 as the IEA now sees a fourth-quarter surplus ([ADVFN](https://uk.advfn.com/market-news/article/26325/brent-and-wti-oil-prices-fall-as-iea-predicts-global-supply-surplus)). The prices below are Friday's close.

Closed 162.85, down about 12.8% on the week (its worst week since March 2025, per the pre-market summaries) and 2-4% lower pre-market. The headline is the CEO exit and the possible return; nothing found changes sales or products. It reports Tue Nov 17 after the close: analysts expect about $108.9B revenue and $2.47 adjusted EPS, against the company's own guide of $108B ±2%. Bernstein counts $164.5B of Nvidia commitments and guarantees to customers' data centres, about $40B of it for AI cloud partners, and says an interim team may be more cautious about new guarantees ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/why-neoclouds-like-coreweave-probably-want-to-see-jensen-huang-return-to-nvidia-133223732.html)). Your lessons L2 and L6 point at the same place: demand quality and the outlook, not the quarter. Wait for a bottom after the report.
